proves.claim: a second command start at the same main tip and HEAD asks for the pinned tool build with no git call and the same answer

cli.io-pinned-tool-build.repeat-read-no-.why: Without it every command start would pay two git processes for an answer that has not changed.

proves.claim: after main or HEAD moves the next start asks git again and picks the new answer

cli.io-pinned-tool-build.tip-moves-rerea.why: Without it a cached answer could outlive the commit it was read at and pin a stale build.
